questions.question: The average height of 5 boys is 175 cm. A sixth boy joined the group and the average height of all the boys in the group now increased by one centimetre. The height of the sixth boys is:
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Height of sixth boys = 175 + 1 × 6 = 181

**Detailed Method:**

Average height of 5 boys = 175

Sum of height of 5 boys = 175 × 5 = 875

Average height of 6 boys = 176

Sum of height of 6 boys = 176 × 6 = 1056

∴ Height of 6th boy = 1056 – 875 = 181

questions.question:
In the figure, two circles with centres P and Q touch externally at R. Tangents AT and BT meet the common tangent TR at T. If AP = 6 cm and PT = 10 cm, then BT =?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e263aee84836a00a5061fb330e09b9a82859ac8b777a42c6eb81efb78e9cc373.png]
questions.solution:
In right-angled ΔPAT, 90 at A.

PT² = AP² + AT²

⇒ 10² = 6² + AT²

⇒ AT² = 100 - 36 = 64

⇒ AT = √64

⇒ AT = 8 cm

As we know,

AT = TR = 8 cm [common tangent]

⇒ TR = TB = 8 cm [common tangent]

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 64 cm. Its area will be;
questions.solution:
As we know,

Perimeter of the square = 4a

Area of square = a²

⇒ 4a = 64

⇒ a = 64/4 = 16

∴ Area of square = 16² = 256

questions.question: The price of sugar is increased by 20% By what percentage must one cut down on the consumption of sugar so that no extra amount has to be incurred on sugar?
questions.solution:
Let the price of the sugar be Rs. 5

Increased price of sugar = 5 × (6/5) = Rs. 6

Ratio of the price of sugar before to increased = 5 : 6

As we know,

Consumption is inversely proportional to price.

Ratio of consumption of price before to after = 6 : 5

∴ Required percentage = (6 - 5)/6 × 100 = 16(2)/(3)\%

questions.question: If angles of a triangle are in the ration of 2 : 3 : 4, then the measure of the smallest angle is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Sum of all three angles of a triangle is 180.

Ratio of three angles of a triangle = 2 : 3 : 4

2 + 3 + 4 = 9 unit

⇒ 9 unit = 180

⇒ 1 unit = 20

⇒ 2 unit = 20 × 2 = 40°

questions.question: Sudhir purchased a laptop for 42,000 and a scanner – cum – printer for 8,000. He sold the laptop for a 10% profit and the scanner – cum – printer for a 5% profit. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price of the laptop = 42000

Profit gain on laptop = 42000 × 10/100 = 4200

Cost price of the scanner – cum – printer = 8000

Profit gain on scanner – cum – printer = 8000 × (5/100) = 400

Total profit = 4200 + 400 = 4600

Total cost price of both articles = 42000 + 8000 = 50000

∴ Profit percentage = 4600/50000 × 100 = 9(1)/(5)\%

questions.question: The greatest number which should be replaced ‘*’ in the number 146*48 to make it divisible by 8 is:

questions.question: Sixteen men can finish a work in 8 days. Eight men and nine women working together can finish the same work in 10 days. In how many days will twenty women finish the same work?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman are x and y respectively

According to the question

16m × 8 = (8m + 9w) × 10

⇒ 128m = 80m + 90w

⇒ 128m – 80m = 90w

⇒ 48m = 90w

m : w = 15 : 8

Total work = 16 × 15 × 8

Let 20 women complete the whole work in x days,

⇒ 20 × 8 × x = 16 × 15 × 8

⇒ x = 12 days

questions.question: A certain amount of money at compound interest grown to Rs. 66,550 in 3 years and Rs. 73,205 in 4 years. The rate per cent per annum is:
questions.solution:
Amount will become in 4 years = 73205

Amount will become in 3 years = 66550

Interest = 73205 - 66550 = 6655

∴ Rate of interest = 6655/66550 × 100 = 10%

questions.question: The distance between two stations, A and B, is 428 km. a train starts from station ‘A’ at 6:00 a.m and moves towards station ‘B’ at an average speed of 48 km/h. Another train starts from station ‘B’ at 6:20 a.m and moves towards statin ‘A’ at an average speed of 55 km/h. At what time will the trains meet?
questions.solution:
Distance between A and B = 428 km

Speed of first train = 48 km/hr

Distanced covered in 20 min by first train = 48/60 × 20 = 16 km

Remaining distance = 428 - 16 = 412 km

Speed of second train = 55 km/hr

If both train running opposite train, then relative speed = 48 + 55 = 103 km/hr

Time = distance/speed = 412/103 = 4 hr

∴ Train meet each other = 6 : 00 + 0 : 20 + 4 : 00 = 10 : 20 a. m
